name: MARN 4030W
title: Chemical Oceanography
description: Composition, origin, and solution chemistry of seawater and the marine biogeochemical cycles of salts, elements, and gases. Distributions and transfer in the marine environment through chemical equilibria, rates, redox, partitioning, ocean circulation, biological cycles, and crustal exchanges.
requirement_description: CHEM 1128Q; MATH 1132Q; PHYS 1202Q or equivalent; ENGL 1007 or 1010 or 1011.
